name: arifOS Observatory WebMCP Surface
description: Browser-native agent tool surface for arifos.arif-fazil.com — constitutional witness, federation observatory, and live reality snapshot. Governed by arifOS constitutional floors F1-F13.

tools.name: get_observatory_snapshot
tools.description: Get the complete signed observatory snapshot — runtime identity, substrate, governance state, capability matrix, organ status, federation edges, intelligence metabolism, evidence chain, and authority gates. Single source of truth for the entire federation state.

tools.name: get_floor_scores
tools.description: Get live F1-F13 constitutional floor scores, verdict posture, verdict decomposition, and governance summary from the arifOS kernel.

tools.name: get_organ_census
tools.description: Get live status of all 7 federation organs: arifOS, GEOX, WEALTH, WELL, AAA, A-FORGE, MCP Gateway. Each organ includes transport state, identity, capability, governance, drift, and dependency info.

tools.name: get_federation_edges
tools.description: Get directed federation edge probes — transport, identity_match, schema_match, session_propagated, actor_propagated, trace_propagated, receipt_produced, and overall health per edge.

tools.name: get_vault_health
tools.description: Get VAULT999 immutable ledger status: seal chain sequence, sources used, source diversity, contradictions, direct vs inferred evidence, and last receipt tier.

tools.name: get_substrate_metrics
tools.description: Get live VPS substrate metrics: CPU percent, memory percent and available bytes, disk percent and free bytes, network I/O, and VAULT999 health.

tools.name: get_capability_matrix
tools.description: Get capability drift matrix — per-tool declared/registered/exposed/invocable/tested status with in/out match and truth verification.

tools.name: get_intelligence_metabolism
tools.description: Get intelligence metabolism stages — each metabolic stage name, value, and confidence from the observation→reasoning→judgment pipeline.

tools.name: get_runtime_identity
tools.description: Get arifOS kernel runtime identity: source commit, deployed commit, build commit, drift state, deployment mode, process started at, platform, kernel epoch.

tools.name: get_constitution
tools.description: Get the arifOS constitution JSON-LD — 13 constitutional floors (F1-F13), ontology terms, governance structure, and sovereign identity. Canonical source for all constitutional queries.

tools.name: get_federation_manifest
tools.description: Get the canonical federation manifest JSON — 8 nodes, 11 edges, transport protocol, stack topology, and live organ health summary.

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: Get the llms.txt context file — plain text summary of all federation endpoints, MCP surfaces, and constitutional doctrine for LLM consumption.

tools.name: verify_did
tools.description: Verify the arifOS root DID (did:web:arif-fazil.com) — returns the DID document with verification methods, key agreement, and service endpoints.

tools.name: get_federation_status
tools.description: Alias for get_organ_census. Returns live status of arifOS, GEOX, WEALTH, WELL, AAA, A-FORGE organs with transport and drift.
